title: Submit your talk for AI DevCon NYC 2026
description:
AI DevCon is returning to Brooklyn, and the CFP is open! We’re looking for practical, experience-driven talks across 4 core areas:

1. Context and harness engineering
2. Agent orchestration and multi-agent systems
3. Agent enablement platforms
4. Software factories and scaling adoption across organizations

We want to hear what you built, what worked, what failed, and what others can learn from it. We want real tools, honest lessons, and ideas that move the industry forward.

Submit your session today: https://sessionize.com/ai-native-devcon-nyc-2026/
